description:
This video is an explanation and a demonstration of the Trendelenburg gait pattern AKA Gluteus Medius Limp. I BEATBOX at the end. 

To understand this gait on a deeper level, watch the video below:

Forces Acting on the HIP | SINGLE LEG STANCE |  What about the CANE? 
https://youtu.be/vYG2Y9Ulp3Q
